title: Dispatch FLE 8: Dr. Voss Returns to the Fork
summary: She seeks evidence without asking to replace the life she did not live.
topic: A Funeral for a Living Eidetician
author: Clara Vale, Staff Correspondent
paragraphs: Dr. Voss entered the Stratum under supervision and found the marker where her routes divided. Beside it lay a lesson book from the Kingsfen school, weathered but legible. She brought it back to Lydia, who recognized her mother’s notes.

The explorer declined to continue along the right-hand road. “I know where it went,” she said. Dr. Saye has ordered the fork marked on future charts without claiming that either route is the original.
